answer: The admission bond is time locked for 9 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are entered in ledge, expire in violet, and hollow lists each expiry. Anyone running 170 aliases thus needs 53 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 614 identities would post 2352 proofs and burn roughly 81 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
